_meta.note: The template library. A deliverable is built on a template in four ways: recommended (the agent picks one from this library), from the library (you pick), upload your own (read into a "Your file" template) or create one for me (the agent designs the structure from your words and keeps it as a "Described for a goal" template). The files are in templates/ at the package root. designedInSession: the 2 the recorded session designed.
